description: This file defines an interface EventStrategy used for handling events within a persistent actor framework. It specifies a method to apply an event to an entity with a particular revision, possibly returning a modified entity or null if the event isn't applicable.

classes.name: EventStrategy
classes.description: A functional interface representing a strategy for handling events of type E on entities of type S, with a method to apply an event to an entity and produce an updated entity.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Applies an event to a given entity at a specific revision, returning the updated entity or null if no applicable strategy is found.
